LUNG.gloss: either of two saclike respiratory organs in the chest of vertebrates
LUNG.definition: Either of two saclike respiratory organs in the chest of vertebrates; serves to remove carbon dioxide and provide oxygen to the blood.

GUY.gloss: an informal term for a youth or man
GUY.definition: An informal term for a youth or man.

GUN.gloss: a weapon that discharges a missile at high velocity
GUN.definition: A weapon that discharges a missile at high velocity (especially from a metal tube or barrel).

SUN.gloss: the star that is the source of light and heat for the planets in the solar system
SUN.definition: The star that is the source of light and heat for the planets in the solar system.
SUN.example: The sun contains 99.85% of the mass in the solar system.

SLUG.gloss: a projectile that is fired from a gun
SLUG.definition: A projectile that is fired from a gun.

SNUG.definition: Offering safety; well protected or concealed.
